## Use this capability when the user means

- map this evidence for me
- show lifeline coverage for this place
- give me map-ready heat or smoke action sites
- show historical river geometry
- return public-safe geospatial evidence
- plot verified infrastructure coverage

## Authority

public-safe evidence-labeled geospatial discovery and read-only projection within access rules

## Boundaries

- coverage gaps must not be overstated as proof of resilience or risk
- no approved machine price is verified
- paid packaging requires explicit terms and confirmation
- private or restricted geospatial evidence remains outside public discovery
